method: For all 26 historical 2020–2025 trade events not in the 18 complete two-sided preview comparisons: join each recorded trade asset to that receiving team roster's same-name starter records in data/player_starts_YEAR.json for weeks strictly greater than transaction week through regular-season week 14. The name-normalization step removes punctuation and trailing Roman II, e.g. DJ Moore and Allen Robinson II; the joined record retains source player IDs, manager roster numbers, week and points. These are *observed actual started points*, not PAR or counterfactual gains. Original historical engine starts may have a different date/season scope, and its differences are retained rather than overwritten. Player never starting after the deal results in observed zero, not automatically a bad trade; missing source player identity requires separate recovery. Historical 2023 team slot 2 belongs to Evans. Multi-manager deals are not pairwise contests. Kenny Gainwell has no starting-lineup entry in the 2023 season archive but is independently identified as provider player ID 7567 in the completed Week 6 transaction receipt; no fabricated start is added.
